observation.qualification: Sampled exact writer closure including shared parent directory allocation and lock. Historical claim siblings/source/runtime outside writer scope; no kernel quota, atomic snapshot, or absent-tree allocation credit.

runtime_temp_cache.qualification: Sampled subset totals already included in the writable union, never charged twice. Includes all scratch/partial files in the selected paths. No hard quota, atomic snapshot, backend-cache maximum or finite inter-sample overshoot bound.

roots.qualification: Sampled non-atomic st_blocks accounting, including directories; no hard filesystem quota or inter-sample growth guarantee. At most three fresh complete scans share one time budget; only singly linked regular files occur in an accepted scan. Transient links may occur between/during discarded observations.
